offering_description.value: The company provides hotel stays and meeting space to travelers and event organizers at its San Francisco hotel. It leases apartments to residents and commercial space to businesses. It also invests its own capital in marketable securities.

primary_services.value: hotel lodging; meeting and banquet services; residential leasing; commercial leasing

customer_segment.value: B2C: individual travelers and residential tenants; B2B: corporate travel buyers, meeting organizers and commercial tenants

end_markets.value: travel and hospitality; meetings and events; rental housing; commercial real estate

revenue_model.value: service fees: nightly hotel stays, banquets and related guest services; rental or leasing: apartment and commercial property leases; other: returns on company-owned securities
revenue_model.category: service fees; rental or leasing; other

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: owns hotel and rental properties serving travelers, event organizers, residents and businesses; other: invests company funds in marketable securities for its own account

geography_served.value: US regional: California, with hotel operations in San Francisco and rental properties concentrated in greater Los Angeles

specialization.value: diversified: hotel operations, residential and commercial rentals, and securities investing for its own account

distribution_channels.value: own locations: hotel front desk and rental property leasing offices; online: hotel brand reservation website; direct sales: hotel group bookings and commercial leasing inquiries

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: hotel health and safety rules, local lodging taxes, and state and local landlord-tenant laws

notes: The current rental portfolio’s full geographic footprint is uncertain.
